text_block_list.text:
At the end of the year, Sakura Bakushin O 
invited me to watch the Arima Kinen, the 
race that would close out the year.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Haa～, I wonder which Uma Musume will win 
this year? I'm starting to get a little 
nervous!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Who did you vote for in the fan vote? You 
know, I voted for――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hoowaaahh…! This is great, there are so 
many people here!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
As class president, I find it far more 
rewarding to organize a class with more 
people than one with fewer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
There are as many troubles as there are 
people! Because there are as many troubles 
as there are class presidents!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ah!! It's about to start!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: Oh, yeah, I'm gonna have to call――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: You over there!! Class is right about to start! Cell phones off!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: Ah, okay! …Class?

――And thus began the Arima Kinen. An Uma 
rushes to the front and pushes forward, 
the pack following her intently…

The sight of the fierce competition 
between such top-notch Uma Musume was so 
intense that it makes the viewer's heart 
beat faster…!
(Woooooahhhh…!!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: …… I was just thoroughly convinced.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
As I thought… That was a race just for me, 
wasn't it!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
How does one become class president, you 
ask!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Is she smart? Can she eat quickly? Is she 
trusted by the teacher? What's her walking 
speed?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
All of these criteria are correct. 
However, the most important thing was not 
there.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, the most important thing is… 
Please answer the question, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Absolutely incorrect!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The correct answer was, "popularity"! The 
class president is the result of 
everyone's confidence in her!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And the "Arima Kinen" is a fan-voted race. 
In a way, it is a gathering of endorsed 
Uma Musume…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I knew it!! It's nothing but a race for 
me, the class president!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Let's definitely, 100% run in it next 
year! The Arima Kinen is waiting for me!

…Distance aptitude makes it nearly 
impossible for her to run the Arima Kinen.

But if she puts this motivation to good 
use and trains hard, she can become even 
stronger than she already is. If that 
happens…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yes!
choice_data_list:
What's the most important thing about 
running the Arima Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: It's being the class president!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What a surprise!? Then, what in the 
world…!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu… I see, I read that. So, in other 
words, Trainer is…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
――You're asking me to further refine my 
speed to take on the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Understood! I shall… take those 
instructions!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Fu-fu-fu… I can already imagine the crowd 
going wild at my speed!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Just a little more patience, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Because I'll run this race with the 
honorable title of class president!

text_block_list.name: Crowd
text_block_list.text: Class president…?

This is how Sakura Bakushin O succeeded in 
igniting her motivation for speed even 
further.
